verdict.rationale: BigQuery documents its own free BigQuery sandbox, which needs no credit card or billing account. It also has a monthly free tier of 10 GiB storage and 1 TiB of queries, and a dry-run option estimates bytes scanned before execution. Together these give a no-cost place to iterate on transformations. However, the sandbox is described as 'limited BigQuery capabilities' meant for evaluating fit, and nothing shows a local engine or emulator, so dev runs still execute on BigQuery's cloud compute. Missing for 10: a local engine or emulator, documentation of which transformation features (e.g. DML, scheduling) work in the sandbox, evidence of a fast iteration loop, and independent hands-on corroboration of using the sandbox for transformation development.
